author: Winston Churchill
text: Success is going from failure to failure without losing your enthusiasm.

author: Carl Jung
text: Who looks outside, dreams; who looks inside, awakes.

author: Epictetus
text: It's not what happens to you, but how you react to it that matters.

author: Friedrich Nietzsche
text: He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.

author: Maya Angelou
text: You may encounter many defeats, but you must not be defeated.

author: Nelson Mandela
text: The greatest glory in living lies not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.

author: Albert Einstein
text: Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep your balance, you must keep moving.

author: Eleanor Roosevelt
text: You must do the thing you think you cannot do.

author: Viktor Frankl
text: When we are no longer able to change a situation, we are challenged to change ourselves.

author: Confucius
text: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.

author: Rumi
text: The wound is the place where the Light enters you.

author: Marcus Aurelius
text: You have power over your mind - not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.

author: Helen Keller
text: The only way to do great work is to love what you do.

author: Steve Jobs
text: Your time is limited, don't waste it living someone else's life.

author: Oprah Winfrey
text: The biggest adventure you can take is to live the life of your dreams.

author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
text: What lies behind us and what lies before us are tiny matters compared to what lies within us.

author: Mark Twain
text: The two most important days in your life are the day you are born and the day you find out why.

author: Muhammad Ali
text: It's not the mountains ahead to climb that wear you out; it's the pebble in your shoe.

author: Theodore Roosevelt
text: Believe you can and you're halfway there.

author: Walt Disney
text: All our dreams can come true, if we have the courage to pursue them.

author: Thomas Edison
text: I have not failed. I've just found 10,000 ways that won't work.

author: Abraham Lincoln
text: The best way to predict your future is to create it.

author: Mother Teresa
text: Be faithful in small things because it is in them that your strength lies.

author: Dalai Lama
text: The purpose of our lives is to be happy.

author: Bruce Lee
text: I fear not the man who has practiced 10,000 kicks once, but I fear the man who has practiced one kick 10,000 times.

author: Henry Ford
text: Whether you think you can or you think you can't, you're right.

author: J.K. Rowling
text: It is our choices that show what we truly are, far more than our abilities.

author: C.S. Lewis
text: You are never too old to set another goal or to dream a new dream.

author: Oscar Wilde
text: Be yourself; everyone else is already taken.

author: Rosa Parks
text: I have learned over the years that when one's mind is made up, this diminishes fear.
